## Description

Server-side PDF (A5) and thermal 80 mm layouts: clinic name/address, GSTIN + CE reg (IN) or TRN + DoH facility (AE), document title (Arabic alt for AE), number, date/time with zone, place of supply (IN tax invoice), against-invoice (credit), patient (MRN; masked EID for AE), consultant/payer block, lines with SAC/CPT, tax, totals (UAE insurer pays / patient co-pay), amount in words, payment block with provider reference, footer notes and QR verify. Share via WhatsApp/email link (P4-009) or print.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Every document type renders for India and UAE matching the design fields; snapshots are approved.
- [ ] **AC2.** A chartered accountant (India) and a UAE tax adviser review and approve the formats (exit gate 2; MDV-P4-031).
- [ ] **AC3.** Thermal layout prints correctly on an 80 mm printer and A5 on standard printers.
- [ ] **AC4.** Documents are stored with hash and are re-printable identically.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
